tools.name: liquidation_price
tools.description: Calculates the liquidation price of an isolated-margin crypto futures position (long or short) from entry price and leverage, the distance to it, and, if a stop-loss is given, whether liquidation would come before the stop and the highest leverage the stop allows. Pure calculation, no market data.

tools.name: position_size
tools.description: Works out how big a trade can be so that hitting the stop-loss loses only the chosen share of the account, fees included, plus the margin needed at a given leverage and whether liquidation comes before the stop. Pure calculation.
